dimensions.assessment: Affects state, tribal, private, and academic entities building weather systems, as well as federal agencies and the public relying on weather forecasts.
dimensions.evidence: State, Tribal, private, and academic entities seeking to build, expand, or upgrade equipment and capacity of mesonet systems.

dimensions.assessment: Provides grants and technical assistance to upgrade weather monitoring stations and integrate data.
dimensions.evidence: award not less than 15 percent of the amount appropriated for the Program for that fiscal year for financial assistance

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes specific funding levels ranging from $50,000,000 for fiscal year 2025 up to $70,000,000 for fiscal year 2029.
dimensions.evidence: (1) $50,000,000 for fiscal year 2025. (2) $55,000,000 for fiscal year 2026. (3) $61,000,000 for fiscal year 2027. (4) $68,000,000 for fiscal year 2028. (5) $70,000,000 for fiscal year 2029.

dimensions.assessment: Provides statutory authority for an existing program, sets grant criteria, requires an advisory committee, and mandates regular briefings.
dimensions.evidence: The Under Secretary shall maintain the National Mesonet Program

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations through fiscal year 2029 and requires briefings through 2035.
dimensions.evidence: Not less frequently than annually through 2035

importance_detail.rationale: Provides statutory authority and authorizations of appropriations up to $70 million annually through fiscal year 2029 for the National Mesonet Program, affecting weather observation data and funding recipients.
